gloss: to become free; to have a moment to spare

definitions.gloss: to become free; to finish what one was doing and be available
definitions.explanation: For one's hands to come free — that is, to finish the task at hand and have time for something else. Literally 'one's hands become empty.' Used constantly at work to offer or ask for help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いたら→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please help me when you're free.
I'm tied up right now — could it wait?

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いて→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{片付|かたづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Whoever was free started clearing up, one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれば→なる：01970_naru⟧{手|て}が{空|あ}く⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧おきます。
examples.english: I should be free in the afternoon, so I'll look over the materials then.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{空|あ}く→空く：11062_aku⟧ (to become empty, to open up).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いたら→空く：11062_aku⟧: when you get a moment
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いて→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be free right now
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いて→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be busy (the standard polite refusal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become free — about having no work at all; {手|て}が{空|あ}く is about the gap between tasks
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}く→空く：11062_aku⟧: to have a slot open up — about the schedule rather than the person
- ⟦{手|て}が{離|はな}せない→手が離せない：06889_tegahanasenai⟧: to be unable to break away — hands literally occupied at this moment

USAGE:
Asking ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いて→空く：11062_aku⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ is gentler than ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧, because it implies you will wait until the person is ready.
